about.body: The AJ133S is Jaguar Land Rover's highest-output version of the 5.0-litre supercharged V8, in production from 2014 to 2024. It's the SVR-specific variant of the AJ133 engine family, tuned to deliver 550-575 hp in the F-Pace SVR and XFR-S. The higher output places additional stress on components, reflected in the rebuild pricing tier. It is the most powerful engine in the Jaguar range during its production period.

byModel.body: The AJ133S appears in two Jaguar applications. In the F-Pace SVR (X761, 2016–2024) , it delivers 550 hp with SVR-specific tuning. In the XF XFR-S (X250, 2013–2015) , the same engine produces 550 hp with its own vehicle-specific calibration. Both applications share the same core engine but differ in ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ133S spans two different model lines with different chassis, ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration vary by application. An AJ133S from an F-Pace SVR isn't a drop-in match for an AJ133S from an XFR-S, even though it's the same base engine code.
